name: handsfree
description: Local small-LLM orchestrator that delegates tasks to frontier-model CLIs (claude, gemini, codex) running headless

scripts.e2e:tui: pnpm build && HANDSFREE_E2E_SKIP_LLM_CHECK=1 vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts e2e/00-tui-visual.e2e.ts
scripts.e2e:core: pnpm build && vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts e2e/01-core-llm.e2e.ts
scripts.e2e:claude: pnpm build && vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts e2e/02-delegate-claude.e2e.ts
scripts.e2e:gemini: pnpm build && vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts e2e/03-delegate-gemini.e2e.ts
scripts.e2e:codex: pnpm build && vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts e2e/04-delegate-codex.e2e.ts
scripts.e2e:smoke: pnpm build && vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts e2e/01-core-llm.e2e.ts e2e/02-delegate-claude.e2e.ts
